notes.title: Patch Update: Play GRANDIA in Chinese and Korean!
notes.notes:
With the latest patch update, fans can now enjoy the GRANDIA series in Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) for the first time, bringing the classic title to a wider audience!

Update Details
For both GRANDIA & GRANDIA II:
- Implemented Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) localization
- Updated Credits to include the staff involved with the new localization
GRANDIA II
- Fixed crash that could occur after defeating the final boss
- Fixed Camera Rotation from defaulting to Right after a game restart

Twitter RT Giveaway
To commemorate the update, we are also giving away T-shirts and Pin Sets on our Twitter
@GungHo_America to 3 lucky winners.

Follow @GungHo_America and Retweet the giveaway post to participate!
The giveaway will run until  June 9th at 11:59PM (PDT)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640968/de11c1937e65e167a7688397823d429c428fb840.png

*Must be 14 or older and must be a resident of the United States of America to participate in the campaign. Upon entering, participants agree to the terms and conditions. Please find our privacy policy here. 



Find out more about GRANDIA HD Remaster and GRANDIA II HD Remaster on its official website. For information on GungHo Online Entertainment America, visit www.gunghoonline.com, or visit GungHo on Twitter or Facebook.

notes.title: Update 1.01.19 is Now Available for GRANDIA II HD Remaster!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9904252/17c5441a680c87c1c410a8acc1bdc613416aaf89.png

Thank you for all of your feedback and support!

Update Version 1.01.19 is here! The Switch version of the GRANDIA Collection has been patched as well.
Please rest assured that the Limited Run Games version will be the new patch version.

Bug Fixes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Fix to crash during cutscene at Garmia Tower
• Fix to missing particle effects during multiple cutscenes
• Fix to black box seen during cutscene at Birthplace of the Gods 3
• Fix to freeze when arriving to Baked Plains from Agear Town in Japanese
• Fix to stutter when entering a battle
• Fix to freeze after battle in Great Rift 2
• Fix to crash while using Snooze after switching accessories during Valmar's Core battle
• Fix to Skill Book tutorial crash while using the Back button for going through text (DE only)
• Fix to enhance frame rate and performance issues in Lumir forest and Ghoss Forest
• Fix to enhance SFX and BGM looping seamlessly throughout locations
• Fix to debug save files in old save slots
• Fix to text and localization bugs
• Fix to other various crashing/freezing issues
• Fix to other minor graphical and visual bugs
• Other bug fixes have been made


Please be sure to check out the physical release of the GRANDIA HD Collection by Limited Run Games! Pre-orders end on September 6th, 2020 at 11:59PM ET!
